steps.name: Capone
steps.text: 9:35. Five minutes late.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We'd better find another place. For safety.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I don't want to spend a second more than I have to, but you know what want even less? To miss our contact.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: He's supposed to come straight to us first thing after getting into Lungmen, but there ain't a single soul coming out of city gate. He's probably stuck somewhere inside. So we wait.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Too many eyes here at the city gateway. You sure you wanna stick around?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What else are we gonna do? We gotta do what the psycho bitch wants!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You remember the first thing she said after she caught us?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: 'Changed my mind. Let's hope you're more useful to me alive than dead.'

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Not that thing! The next one!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: 'Don't blow this. Mess up a single time, I cut your throats.'

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: So, so instead of risking missin' our guy and losin' the letter, I'd rather be a little more conspicuous.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You—Whatever.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: There's the crowd.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What does the guy look like again?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Don't hurt yourself trying to remember. It's not going to happen.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: *sigh*.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The broad never said anything about what our contact looked like or what he's wearin'. He'll come to us, not the other way around.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You remember how the meeting goes down, right?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gambino?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: The contact asks us, 'Would you like some mayonnaise teppanyaki macaroni,' we'll tell him, 'Supersize, for two,' and he'll give us the letter.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm impressed.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Just hearing that password makes me wanna puke. Couldn't forget it even if I wanted to.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's 9:50. Even the last group into the city is gone by now.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Something must've gone wrong. We should move.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What if he shows and we ain't here?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Like that could happen. We can't just stand around any longer!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Maybe customs busted him?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Even if not, no harm in waitin' for him a little longer. It's his own damned fault he didn't find us. The crazy bitch can't do nothing about that...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What's the difference?!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: She's off her goddamned rocker. She ain't gonna think about who's at fault here, it's all about results! If you don't move your furry ass right now, you're signing our death certificates!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Alright, let's say I do it your way. Where do we look for him?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Use your brain.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Only a Siracusan would write the looney broad a letter. Aside from Penguin Logistics, who else in Lungmen's got anythin' to do with Siracusa?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You tellin' me it's the traitors we brought with us from the old country?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Not only did they betray us, they're nabbing our guy?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Heh, guess you do still got a couple of brain cells to rub together.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Can't say for sure it was them, but they do fit the profile. They're gonna know something, at least.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Andiamo.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Those traitorous cazzi. One day, I swear I'm gonna—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hold it!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I've been telling you since the first day we stepped into Lungmen. They got their own rules here.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Don't forget how we lost to the Rat King, and how he let us go without a scratch.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Don't need the reminder, Capone!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I sure hope so.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: So, we're droppin' in on the traitors' hideout. We ain't there to pick a fight or teach 'em a lesson. Just doin' a little information gathering. You hear me?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Slow down. This is the place.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Never better.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What's the plan? Grab a couple and start askin' questions?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Probably a better way.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If they're the mooks who kidnapped our Messenger guy from Siracusa, then it's somethin' their bosses cooked up. And if it wasn't them, then these small timers ain't gonna know anything.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: It's times like these you actually give that brain a little workout, huh?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: So, how are we runnin' this one? Like we did in the old days? You go make some noise while I sneak in?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Not so fast. We gotta case the joint a little longer. Don't take a risk if their guard is low enough.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We're working for the crazy broad. I need all the help I can get, even if you usually do more harm than good.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hah, listen to yourself. If it wasn't for me, you woulda screwed up enough for the psycho to run you through.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Haha, twenty-one!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Hell yeah, come to papa!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Hold on, what the hell's that?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: What's what? You better pay up—

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: We got a cheat!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) The lookouts are playin' cards in broad daylight?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) If I were their boss, I'd shove the whole deck down their throats.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) Save it. Who do you even think you are now?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) Besides, it's pretty convenient for us they ain't payin' attention.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: *Sigh*... I lost big this time.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Haven't been paid jack for a while now. Wouldn't've been playin' otherwise.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: What, you think I'm loaded? You were tryin' to steal from me!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Your turf is close to the markets. At least you can pick up some odd jobs and run errands around there. Me? I gotta stroll around the Infected camp. Place's like a graveyard. No work at all, even if I tried looking for some!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Odd jobs?!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: What? What was that?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I heard someone say something just now, and pretty damned close.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: What did they say?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I think it was... 'odd jobs?'

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Hahahaha... You're hearin' things. Or some punk's tryin' to spook you.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) Are you outta your mind?!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) No...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) Back when we picked up these kids, when we made them Gambinos, Sicilians...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) Did ever think they'd end up... errand boys?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) Outta my mind? What was all those years of blood, sweat, and tears for? What are they in this for?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) To live another day, you egomaniac!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) This is all good news, with the shape we're in. And you're complaining?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) Of course I'm complaining! How am I supposed—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Shit! They're packing heat?!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No, that's an Originium explosion. A couple blocks away, from the sound of it—Where are you going?!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You wanna stay here your whole life?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Slow down!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: G-Gambino, you're running too—
Capone suddenly finds himself speechless, just as Gambino did when he reached the area a dozen or so seconds ago.
A man wearing a black hat and raincoat stands in front of them.
A number of local Lungmenite triads lies on the ground around him. Some of them are unconscious, while others are groaning as they hold their wounds, but they are all alive.

steps.name: Man in Black
steps.text: Would you like some mayonnaise teppanyaki macaroni?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Yeah... Supersize, for two.

steps.name: Man in Black
steps.text: Buon appetito.
Capone walks a few steps forward and takes a letter from the man in black.
The wax seal on the envelope seems familiar, but he doesn't immediately recognize what it represents.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Buongiorno, which family do you—

steps.name: Man in Black
steps.text: Boss—No, Mr... Gambino?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Tommaso?!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What are you doing here—No, who gave you this letter? Where's the guy you got this from?

steps.name: Tommaso
steps.text: I-I don't know! The letter's from me!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I know what kind of man you are, Tommaso. You can't fool me.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I know you don't have what it takes to put all these men on the ground by yourself. They'd beat you half-dead. The letter man's gotta be the one who did this.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You'll tell me where he went, if you know what's good for you.

steps.name: Tommaso
steps.text: I... I can't.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Looks like you got pretty forgetful since I been gone.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Then I guess I'll gotta squeeze it outta you! You'll beg for death.

steps.name: Tommaso
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Tommaso
steps.text: I won't tell you, no matter what! Not even if you kill me!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Alright, you asked for it—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gambino!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Since when did you get all sentimental? If we find the letter man, we might just get a way out of this godforsaken town, back to...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Look at the envelope, the seal. Don't tell me you don't know what that is.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: It's... from her? Why would she... Why's she thinkin' about Lungmen?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Crap, it's the L.G.D.! They're here lookin' into the blast!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Tommaso, come with us—

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: He's gone?!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Don't worry about him. We're in enough trouble!

steps.name: Indistinct Voice
steps.text: Drop your weapons... surrounded...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: This way.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: That's a dead end!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Trust me! Hurry!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: I-Is this a gang war?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: No, looks more like a one-sided power move... See? They're all alive.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: You're right. They're hurt pretty damned bad, though.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: The perp can't be far! Let's move!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Which way?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: We have patrols on both ends of the street. If they had even half a brain, they'd have gone down this alley.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Hah, I know this alley. It's a dead end.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) This is your idea of a way out?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) Didn't you hear 'em? They got men posted on both ends of the street. We're trapped!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Alright, come on out. You can't hide!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Seeing as you didn't kill any of them, we'll go easy on you.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Stop resisting. Come out already!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) They're gonna find us!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) Shut up. I'm thinking. I'm thinking...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: We know you're hiding behind that wall. Drop your weapons and come on out!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: (Quietly) Got anything yet?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Quietly) I'm thinking. I'm—

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: I'll say it again. Drop your weapons, and we'll go easy—

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: In your dreams!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Freeze—

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Stop! Stop right there!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Now, make a run for it!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: What? He's got an accomplice. Is this a diversion? Quick! Call for backup—

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: He's got at least one accomplice. They have crossbows. Terrible aim!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Terrible what?!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If this wasn't Lungmen, I woulda blown your brains out!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: They probably won't catch us here.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: All we ever do these days is run, hmph. And all because of a few punks?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's just like you to say that, you egomaniac.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That arrogant air of yours gets more intense the harder we're screwed. It pisses me off more than it did when we were young.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What? Takin' a trip down memory lane?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: A little.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I still remember who gave me this last arrow wound here.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: And if I weren't in the same boat as that cazzo right now, I'd give him one to match, a little closer to his heart. No point in going down memory lane otherwise.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Yeah, you're damned right.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And I'd love to stick another arrow in that arrogant bastard. The brain this time. I won't miss.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hah, nice. If you wanna do me in so badly, why don't we get right down to it?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You think I'm scared of you?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What else could it be? You couldn't take me down, not without gettin' the jump on me.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Sure, I couldn't take you in a fight.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Oh? Finally admitting it?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Don't forget who we work for... You brought her up earlier, now it's my turn to remind you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Looks like you're still sane enough to calm down. Thank God.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm still worried, though. After all, we didn't get the letter from the real contact. You think that crazy broad might say we messed up?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hell would I know?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: All I know is the two of us together wouldn't last ten seconds against her.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Ain't like we got a choice, so why worry about it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I can smell you two through the door. You've been standing outside for a while. What's up?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: N-Nothing, ma'am. All's well. Everythin's just fine. We got the letter.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Everything's fine?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Yeah, it all went really well. Great, even.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It all went well, but it took you this long to come back?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Show me the letter.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: D-Done already? Y-You read it that fast?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Got a problem?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: N-No, not at all. No problems with that. Not a single one. No opinions even.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Feels like you still have something to say, though?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What he's tryin' to say is... Does that letter talk about us at all?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, hahahahaha.... HAHAHAHAHA!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The letter says I can deal with you two however I like.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What's the matter? No reaction to that bit of information?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Is... Is that really it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Heh, never would've thought. You've got a nose for this sort of thing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The letter says that, considering what absolute failures, what miserable embarrassments you two have been, I should dig a hole somewhere out in the barrenlands and leave you six feet deep.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You don't seem very surprised.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What's to be surprised about? Even I think we're embarrassing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So, what'cha gonna do?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Take your own lives in disgrace?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You could try to make a run for it again. I'll give you fifteen whole seconds this time.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Don't joke about that. We know the score.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Alright, I have another idea.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You two never actually meant all that much to them in the first place.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You know their rules, right? Stop fooling yourselves. Signora Sicilia isn't going to care about two rabid stray dogs. Hell, she doesn't even care about me.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You two know what that means. It's Siracusa itself that wants you two gone.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I don't really care much about that, but even I think you two desperate puppies are a pathetic sight.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So, why don't you duel it out?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That'll get you back some of that so-called honor, the one who wrote the letter ends up in a better mood, and I'll get me some quiet time.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: How about it? Whaddya think?!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: A blood pact, then...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: If we go against the letter's instructions, betray our own Family, and even make a pact with you, you'll only be able to protect the one who lives, right?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Pact? Protect? Betrayal?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do I have to tell you guys how many times you've stabbed each other in the back? Me?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Alright... I accept.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Capone?!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Didn't you just tell me there's no point in going down memory lane?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Alright, I'm in. I'll count to three, and that's when we'll go. We'll see who lives.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And by the way, I didn't strike before I finished talkin'. That's me makin' it up to you for all those times I stabbed you in the back.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Alright, traitor. We'll call it square.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Tre...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Due...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Uno!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Fight!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hahahaha... Hahahahaha! HAHAHAHA!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I love that!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: More! Give me more! Free the hate in your hearts! Show me just how far you can go when your lives are on the line!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gambino, now!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Graaaahhhh!!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Take this—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: To the left!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No way... She didn't even draw her sword—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Amateurs. I know where your attacks are coming from without even really looking.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You make a good couple of brothers. The dumb one is dumb as hell, and the one that looks smart only looks it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I bet you two didn't have it that hard back in Siracusa when you were little. Life must've been comfortable?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gambino, don't give her the room to talk—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No way! Barehanded?!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Is that so surprising?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's like we come from two totally different Siracusas.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Just like this.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: How does it feel to have your own crossbow bolt pressed against your throat?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Can't say I'm feelin' a lot.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Since you didn't like my idea, I'll have to follow the letter and dispose of you two in whatever way pleases me.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You forgot about one thing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: This is Lungmen.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You can't cut a throat with rubber-tipped bolts!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I knew you had a knife on you. Didn't expect you to be so quick to draw it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But still... too slow!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gugh—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And sure, these bolts with rubber heads can't kill.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But it's not so hard to find your aorta.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: *chokes*

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Capone?!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Ugh... Guh—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Congrats. You saved your life.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: *cough*... So what? You're still gonna...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Save it, Capone.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We should've died here a long time ago. Let's at least go out like real Sicilians.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh?
For a brief moment, Gambino and Capone think they are seeing things.
They see Lappland holding the exquisitely decorated envelope and the neatly unfolded letter above an open flame.
A corner of the letter lights up.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Are you nuts?! You... You burned Signora Sicilia's letter?!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh? You didn't think I was nuts?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's a letter full of pretentious, make-believe honor tripe. Feels much better to just burn it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: This... crazy bitch...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What, you're going to stick up for her?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Now that's the truth. You wouldn't dare. Neither of you. Whether it's baring your fangs against her or sticking up for her, you wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You think she chased you out of your homeland, but you don't dare speak up.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Aren't you angry? Don't you think it's her fault you got exiled from Siracusa?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Are you really so scared of her? Even though she says right in the letter she wants you dead, you still can't stand seeing that very letter burn?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Ugh. Lame.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Get up.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Where are you... taking us?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Taking you? Why should I have to take you anywhere?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Aren't you going to bury us out in the wastes?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What you two did was clumsy as hell, but it wasn't like, completely embarrassing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Also, the letter's gone now, so why should I still listen to her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Alright, get up!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You've got work to do. You can't just be lying around on the ground.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What work?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There's more than one lone wolf in this city.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: What do you think of Lungmen tea?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Seems it's not to your taste. I've heard Siracusans only drink tea when they're sick.
I couldn't have said it better.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But this is Lungmen, and we Lungmenites like our tea with more leaves, Mr. Cadeddu.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: I have no opinion. I'm only here as a Messenger of the signora.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: But I hope you can understand that, no matter which land we walk, Siracusans are always Siracusans, and we Siracusans don't drink lukewarm tea.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Sure, but some of our friends from Siracusa have come to enjoy the aroma of our tea. Do you, or perhaps the signora you represent, really plan on forcing some other beverage into their mouths?

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: The signora has no plans to interfere with them. Out of our respect for you, and as an apology for their transgression in Lungmen, you may deal with them as you see fit.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have to apologize to you, too. This morning, our locals mistook for an accomplice of theirs. That's why they brought you to their hideout.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Thank you for not killing any of them.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Please, no thanks necessary.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Well, then, if there is nothing else...

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Sorry, but there is.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Please, by all means.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: The signora has no intention of dealing with that undisciplined bunch in any way, but there are two men we must do something about.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You mean those two 'lone wolves?'

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Showing the rest of them leniency is the most that the signora can tolerate, but she will not allow these two to cut ties with the pack.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have heard a few things about them. We won't interfere with the mutual grudge they hold with Siracusa.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: We appreciate your understanding.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Furthermore, you can rest assured that we will refrain from doing anything unnecessary during their stay in Lungmen. However, if they spend too much time outside fooling around, we will have to interfere.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: As long as you do so within the bounds of Lungmen's rules.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: We will try, but we can't promise anything.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Is that a threat?

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Certainly not.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Then your choice of the word 'try' is quite worth chewing over.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I will get to the point. You don't want to break Lungmen's rules while you are in Lungmen.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: We don't want to, of course. To tell the truth, if we had the choice, we definitely wouldn't want any kind of conflict between us and Lungmen or its mighty Yanese protector.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You think too highly of an old man like me.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: But some things must be done. I hope you can understand.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Then, for both our sakes, let us pray things won't progress to that point.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Pray? Can I take it that's where you stand?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: With my greatest respect for Lady Sicilia, yes. That's where I ultimately stand.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Very well, I understand.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: To the best of our ability, we will try to keep things from progressing to that point.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Please excuse me now.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Thank you for your hospitality. If the opportunity arises, perhaps we can invite you to Siracusa for a cup of quadruplo espresso?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I appreciate it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But, first thing's first, won't you finish that tea?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: A guest must wholeheartedly accept their host's hospitality. This, too, is one of Lungmen's rules.
The black-clad Siracusan takes the teacup in front of him and finishes it in one go.

steps.name: Cadeddu
steps.text: Will this do?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Of course, my dear friend. Please travel safe.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Is he gone?

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: He is. Our men followed him until he left the city. It didn't look like he was going to change disguises or anything.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You heard my conversation with the man just now, right?

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Get the word out. I want everyone to keep an eye out the Siracusan mafia.

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: As for the two lone wolves... We have Emperor keeping an eye on one of them. I'm not worried about her. But the other, keep a close eye on her until she leaves Lungmen.

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: And what do we do if she doesn't leave?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Today is Friday, isn't it?

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: That's right, but... What do you mean?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If memory serves, everyone always calls it... something Friday... What was it again? I can't say I know how you youngsters talk these days.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Anyway, Ice Castle Hotel has 30% off today, doesn't it?

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: Uhh... I'll ask.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If they're running the discount, book a dinner for two for tonight.

steps.name: Subordinate
steps.text: Dinner for two... Understood! On it!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Calm down. I'm just going to eat with an old friend.
